title: A New Framework for Acquisition and Processing of Event-driven 4D STEM
content: With the introduction of pixelated detectors into scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), the amount of data that is generated by a single scan has seen an enormous increase and is now routinely in the tens or hundreds of Gb/scan regime. Event-driven direct electron detectors, like e.g. those based on the Timepix3 chip, hold great promise for electron microscopy, especially for low-dose 4D STEM experiments [1] and their live processing possibilities [2]. The use of the most efficient representation of an electron's information is crucial for the current advances to be scalable and thus enabling them to become widespread and routine in the field.
